name: Operational issue and attachment-correction email chain
producer: Operations manager, analyst, and external counterparty
purpose: Coordinate an operational exception, circulate support, correct one attachment, and leave a bounded open item.
medium: Native MIME email thread with ordinary attachments
lifecycle: Sent and received thread retained in the project file

natural_depth: Initial request and incomplete first response
Internal shorthand and external formal reply
One unresolved owner and due date

features: One printed retained copy only if separately manifested

prohibited: Perfectly complete reply from every participant
Attachment facts absent from the attachments
Thread that directly states the task answer
proof_gates: Check chronological and role knowledge boundaries
Confirm no duplicate or impossible message IDs
